# SellerChecking

> > AliExpress seller verification and rating platform for Chinese brands and suppliers with comprehensive seller profiles and product catalogs.

SellerChecking provides detailed ratings, reviews, and verification data for AliExpress sellers and Chinese brands. The platform helps buyers identify trustworthy suppliers across categories including jewelry, footwear, craft supplies, and consumer goods by aggregating seller performance metrics and store listings.

## Key Topics

- AliExpress seller verification
- Chinese brand directory
- Seller ratings and reviews
- LINSION jewelry
- Overself footwear
- City Class apparel
- Craft supplies and diamond painting
- Dropshipping suppliers
- Store quality metrics
- Product catalogs from China
- Punk jewelry and pendant chains
- VogueCode accessories
- SINGLE ROSE footwear
- Winifred brand products
- Seller performance analysis

## Core Platform Features

- [AliExpress Seller Check](https://sellerchecking.com/): Homepage for AliExpress seller verification, ratings, and reviews service
- [Product catalog from China](https://sellerchecking.com/c): Main catalog of verified Chinese products with seller verification
- [Chinese Brands On SellerCheck](https://sellerchecking.com/b): Directory of Chinese brands available on AliExpress with rankings
- [AliExpress Suppliers And Sellers Rating](https://sellerchecking.com/r): Top-rated AliExpress sellers ranked by internal quality metrics
